judgment.explanation: 浮圗 is the crown prince (太子) of 臨兒國, identified in the annotation as the Buddha (浮屠). The candidate c0 is the local person form 浮圗 directly from the source text, matching the mention exactly. The text '其國王生浮圗 浮圗者太子也' and '浮屠者身服色黃' identify 浮圗/浮屠 as the Buddha. The candidate is the historical referent.

屑頭邪 is identified in the annotation as the father of the crown prince (浮圗). The candidate c0 is the local person form 屑頭邪 directly from the source text, matching the mention exactly. The text '父曰屑頭邪' confirms this role. The candidate is the historical referent.

莫邪 is identified in the annotation as the mother of the crown prince (浮圗). The candidate c0 is the local person form 莫邪 directly from the source text, matching the mention exactly. The text '母曰莫邪' confirms this role. The candidate is the historical referent.

伊存 is identified in the annotation as the envoy (使) of the Great Yuezhi king (大月氏王) who orally transmitted the Buddhist scripture to 景慮. The candidate c0 is the local person form 伊存 directly from the source text, matching the mention exactly. The text '大月氏王使伊存口傳浮屠經' confirms this role. The candidate is the historical referent.
傅毅 is a full personal name appearing in the annotation as the person who responds to Han Mingdi. The candidate c0 is directly sourced from this annotation text and matches the surface form exactly.

王遵 is a full personal name appearing in the annotation as one of the twelve people sent to the Yuezhi kingdom. The candidate c0 is directly sourced from this annotation text and matches the surface form exactly.
沙律 is a personal name appearing in the annotation as a divine person (神人) in 天竺. The candidate c0 is directly sourced from this annotation text and matches the surface form exactly.

殷中軍 refers to Yin Hao (殷浩) by his office title 中軍. Both candidates c0 and c1 are prior-candidate entries for 殷中軍 from different candidate databases (wave-a and wave-b). Both plausibly refer to the same historical person (殷浩), but the supplied candidates are duplicate database entries rather than distinct historical referents. The mention is supported as referring to 殷浩, but the two candidate keys represent the same person from different retrieval waves, making the choice between them ambiguous. The historical referent is present in the candidate set.

The mention 牟子 appears in the Liu annotation as part of the phrase 牟子傳記 (Mouzi's biography/record), referring to the author of a Buddhist-related text. The supplied candidate c0 is simply the surface form 牟子 itself, retrieved from the same annotation. The text does not provide sufficient biographical or identifying details to confirm the historical identity of this 牟子 (who could be 牟融 or another historical figure associated with the 牟子 text). The evidence only shows the name appearing in the annotation as the author of a record, but does not establish which specific historical person this refers to. Therefore the evidence is insufficient to confirm the candidate as the historical referent.

records.explanation: 其母 refers to the mother of 浮圗 (the subject of the preceding passage). The text says '其母夢白象而孕及生從右脅出' — his mother dreamed of a white elephant and became pregnant, and he was born from her right side. This mother is 莫邪, mentioned earlier in annotation 006 as '母曰莫邪'. The mother is distinct from her son 浮圗 and from the king (her husband).
records.referent_role: the mother of 浮圗 (the Buddha)

records.explanation: 浮圗 is the son born to the king of 臨兒國. The text says '其國王生浮圗 浮圗者太子也' — 浮圗 is the crown prince. This 浮圗 is the same person as 浮屠 (the Buddha) mentioned earlier in the same annotation.
records.referent_role: 浮圗, the son of the king of 臨兒國 (i.e., the Buddha)

relations.predicate_surface: 臣聞天竺有道者號曰佛
對曰臣聞天竺有道者號曰佛
其母夢白象而孕及生從右脅出

assertions.exact_span: 漢明帝夜夢神人身有日光明
assertions.interpretation: 漢明帝夜夢神人，遂博問群臣，傅毅對以天竺有道者號佛，此為佛經傳入中國的另一傳說時間點。
漢武故事記載昆邪王殺休屠王來降，得其金人神像置於甘泉宮，此神類於佛，但漢武帝時佛經可能尚未行於中土。

assertions.exact_span: 殷中軍見佛經云理亦應阿堵上
assertions.interpretation: 殷中軍（殷浩）見到佛經，說道理也應該在此（佛經）之上，此為故事發生的場景時間。
漢明帝遣使廣求異聞，此為佛經傳入中國的又一背景時間事件。

assertion.interpretation: 劉向/魚豢之說中記載漢哀帝元壽元年博士弟子景慮受大月氏王使伊存口傳浮屠經，為佛經傳入中國的早期時間點。
魏略西戎傳記載漢成帝、哀帝之間已有佛經，與牟子傳記所說時間不同。

assertion.exact_span: 牟傳所言四十二者其文今存非妄
assertion.interpretation: 牟子傳記所言四十二部佛經其文至今仍存，並非虛妄，說明明帝遣使廣求異聞時並非當時無經。
assertion.surface: 牟子傳記所述四十二部經

assertion.interpretation: 劉孝標注指出佛經傳入中國的起始時間不詳（莫詳其始），牟子之說為其一說。

assertion.exact_span: 蘭臺石室劉子政列仙傳曰
assertion.interpretation: 劉子政（劉向）在蘭臺石室撰列仙傳，歷觀百家之中以相檢驗，得仙者百四十六人，其中七十四人已在佛經。
浮屠經記載天竺臨兒國國王生浮圖（佛），其母夢白象而孕，從右脅出，此為佛之誕生的傳說背景。
